risks.risk: Exact Xbox One variant (original, S, or X) affects value and storage tier.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the console's rear/side nameplate or Settings > Console info screen showing model and storage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as base/original Xbox One with unknown (assume lowest standard) storage.

risks.risk: Games may be digital licenses tied to seller's Microsoft account rather than physical discs, meaning they may not transfer to buyer.
risks.proof: Screenshot of 'My Games & Apps' showing ownership, or physical game discs photographed with the console.
risks.if_unproven: Price as console-only; do not add value for the claimed 6-game library.

risks.risk: Disc drive and internal hardware condition (read errors, overheating, fan noise) cannot be assessed from static photos.
risks.proof: Short video clip of console powering on, loading a disc, and running a game for a minute with audible fan.

risks.risk: Only one controller is shown; accessories (power brick, HDMI cable, extra controllers) not confirmed included.
risks.proof: Photo of full accessory bundle laid out together with the console.
risks.if_unproven: Price for console plus single controller only, no extras.

risks.risk: Controller functionality (stick drift, button wear) cannot be seen from photos.
risks.proof: Video clip showing controller in use with visible stick/button response in a game menu.

risks.risk: Stickers on the console top may be concealing scratches, dents, or heat damage underneath.
risks.proof: Photo with stickers removed or close-up of casing condition where stickers are not present.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cosmetically worn/unknown condition underneath stickers.

risks.risk: Monitor shown is for demonstration only and may not be included in the sale.
risks.proof: Seller confirmation and photo showing monitor packaged/labeled as part of the listing.
risks.if_unproven: Price console and controller only, excluding monitor.

proof_requests: Photo of console rear/bottom nameplate or System Info screen showing exact model (One/One S/One X) and storage capacity.
Screenshot of full 'My Games & Apps' library showing all 6 claimed titles and whether they are disc-based or digital.
Short video of console booting, loading a game, and running briefly to check disc drive and fan/overheating.
Photo of controller with full accessory bundle (power brick, HDMI cable, extra controllers if any).
Close-up photo of console casing with stickers removed or avoided, to check for hidden damage.
Clarify whether the Dell monitor is included in the sale.
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is a standard Xbox One (not the 'Series X' the seller implies) with only FC 26 verified on screen; everything else, including the other five claimed games, console variant/storage, and accessory completeness, is unverified or unverifiable remotely, so it must be priced at the worst-case base console with a single controller and FC 26 only.
